Attached: 1 image

No motivation? Check the task before you blame yourself.

Ask what is in the way. If it is unclear, write one sentence on what "done" looks like. If it is too big, cut out a piece you can finish in ten minutes. If it is dull, set a fifteen-minute timer and let yourself stop when it rings. Then do only that first piece.

Often the task needs fixing, not you.

#habits #productivity
